preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 1 + 3*P lines, where P is the number of provinces read from the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(lines[1 + 3*k]) <= 600 for k in range(P))
preconditions.description: For each province, the integer N (number of columns) is between 1 and 600 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines[2 + 3*k]) == int(lines[1 + 3*k]) and len(lines[3 + 3*k]) == int(lines[1 + 3*k]) for k in range(P))
preconditions.description: For each province, the two row strings have length exactly equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in lines[2 + 3*k]) and all(c.islower() for c in lines[3 + 3*k]) for k in range(P))
preconditions.description: All characters in the province grid strings are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly P lines, one for each province.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[k] == str(count_distinct_minimal_paths(N_k, row1_k, row2_k)) for k in range(P))
postconditions.description: For each province k, the output line is the count of distinct strings formed by all minimal-length paths that visit every cell in the 2xN grid at least once, where N_k, row1_k, and row2_k are the parsed inputs for that province.
